mission.title: headlamp: Distributed Headlamp settings
mission.description: Distributed Headlamp settings. Requested by 13+ users.

steps.title: Check current headlamp deployment
steps.description:
Verify your headlamp version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n headlamp -l app.kubernetes.io/name=headlamp
helm list -n headlamp 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working headlamp installation.

steps.title: Review headlamp configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant headlamp configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n headlamp -l app.kubernetes.io/name=headlamp
kubectl get configmap -n headlamp -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=headlamp
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for Distributed Headlamp settings
steps.description:
wrote in #4280 

# Persistent storage for configuration of Headlamp and Headlamp plugins

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the impact that the lack of the feature requested is creating.
From what I understand in the Headlamp's source code, configuration settings like
```yaml
plugins: {
  headlamp-k8s.flux: { // Plugin official name
    hide-empty-charts: true,
  }
}
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n headlamp -l app.kubernetes.io/name=headlamp
kubectl get events -n headlamp --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Distributed Headlamp settings" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
wrote in #4280 

# Persistent storage for configuration of Headlamp and Headlamp plugins

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the impact that the lack of the feature requested is creating.
codeSnippets:
config:
  watchPlugins: true
pluginsManager:
  enabled: true
  configContent: |
    plugins:
      - name: my-plugin
        source: https://artifacthub.io/packages/headlamp/my-repo/my_plugin
        version: 1.0.0
    installOptions:
      parallel: true
      maxConcurrent: 2
  baseImage: node:lts-alpine
  version: latest

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with headlamp installed or the issue environment reproducible.
